name: Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich on Plain White Bun
whyItWorks: A tender, boneless grilled chicken breast served on a soft white burger bun provides high-quality lean protein without batter, grease, or high-fiber roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order plain (grilled chicken breast and bun only). Skip lettuce, tomato, raw red onion, pickles, and fry sauce.
